Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Neha Nambiar. I am a 50-year-old hardware dealer living in Mysuru. I paid Pillai Constructions INR 1,39,00,000/- for a flat, and the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate. My case number is C.C. No. 2928/2020 in the Mysuru District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 69079 35518 or email neha.nambiar50@example.com.

spans.text: Mysuru District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
age (50) + occupation (hardware dealer) + city (Mysuru) + issue (consumer complaint)
